definition.silhouette: Open angular headwrap, broad layered black mantle, segmented shoulder bands, reinforced forearm and three hanging ampoules; wider upper silhouette with long uneven robe panels
definition.weakness: Distinct one-charge action-cost Basic Curse casting pose; no free cast or transformation

emblem.policy: Leave emblem fields blank in guides. Obtain a genuine official Riot Noxus emblem, preserve exact source URL/bytes/hash and permissions before final painted art. Never invent a crest or reuse Demacia heraldry.

generation.prompt: Exact prompts and hashes in painted-v2-finish/*-strip-v1.generation.json and generation-batch-01 through07.

model_sheet_type: Editable own volumetric rig plus actual generated painted candidates; rig guides remain non-final reference inputs

painting_contract.camera: One measured uniform camera/placement correction per action atlas, preserve every source and rejected revision; no per-frame stretch, warping, auto-fit or idle-as-action
painting_contract.continuity: Use each unit's own model/upgrade definition and all actual pose guides; preserve joint contacts and independent silhouettes
painting_contract.required_capability: ChatGPT image-generation skill / built-in image_gen.imagegen or human painted masters
review: transparent background and no baked floor
whole action semantics and projectile release
genuine Noxus emblem legibility and provenance
painting_contract.style: Original Heroes III native painted/prerendered treatment, restrained highlights, matte iron/crimson/black, upper-left lighting; not glossy modern 3D, flat vector or splash art

pipeline: Historical own rig/pose guides and rejected atlases preserved; none supply final pixels
29 genuine focused imagegen strips preserved locally with prompts/provider/model-not-exposed/source hashes
Connected-figure alpha extraction, uniform per-strip camera scale and planted-contact translation
